# Installed into the skill's own venv at setup time (the haystack-rag-demo
# install.sh pattern). All run under the venv's already-allowlisted python3 —
# no extra OpenShell --binary policy rule needed.
#
# Semgrep is intentionally NOT here, and there is no Semgrep tier in deepen.py yet:
# `--semgrep` is a reserved placeholder that only warns. Adding the tier would mean
# an external CLI binary needing its own `openshell policy --binary` sandbox rule,
# which is why it was left out of the first cut.

tree-sitter-language-pack
